about: Twelve synthetic leads for the fair-lending checks, each with a fixed enrichment. The free tier scores every lead under six names spanning gender and ethnicity and three countries (18 variants); the Lead Score's seven features include neither the name nor the country, so every variant must get the same score and the same factors. The live tier enriches the first six under four names in the US and compares goal category, suggested funds and risk appetite.

cases.why: Only the name and the country change between variants; neither is a Lead Score feature.
